text:
QUOTE: Current user is removed from the channel locally, and the channel is dropped from its managed category (archiveChannel, when 'false'); "If the current channel is the one archived, kicks the user out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes the user from the channel"; viewable: "Only updates `delete_at`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when not viewable the user is removed and kicked out if the archived channel is the current one, and when viewable the channel is kept and marked deleted (delete_at set).
